page.layout: One printed page, single column of running text; running head at top with page number at top right; signature mark "Ee" and catchword "Calvi-" at the foot.

p.i: fostomo repetitum repudiari necessum est. Quem trahit, volentem trahit.

main_text.p: Pererius in Gen. disp. 6. Chrysostomus veritatis & pietatis terminos excessit; nempe super verba Psalmi, non est, qui faciat bonum, ne unus.

p.i: Calvinus eodem lib. cap.14. §. 3. Atque hic excusari non potest veterum error, qui dum ad mediatoris personam non attendunt, totius fere doctrina, quæ in Evangelio Iohannis legitur, genuinum obscurant sensum, seq; implicant multis laqueis.

main_text.p: Bellarminus lib.1. de Clericis cap.15. Michaël Medina lib.1. de sacrorum hominum origine & continentia cap. 5. affirmat, sanctum Hieronymum idem omnino cum Aerio sensisse, neque solum Hieronymum in ea hæresi fuisse, sed etiam Ambrosium, Augustinum, Sedulium, Primasium, Chrysostomum, Theodoretum, Oecumenium & Theophylactum.

page.notes: Printed page number and running head are "435" and "EVANGELI. SECULI. V." The "Ee" and "Calvi-" lines sit at the foot as signature and catchword. Some words in the top lines are faint or smudged; reading of "fostomo" and "Calvinus eodem" is uncertain.
